# Burhani Masjid

> Burhani Masjid is a mosque in Al Qusais, Dubai, serving the emirate's Dawoodi Bohra community. It was inaugurated in 2004. Beyond daily prayers it functions as a centre for religious learning and community gatherings, and in 2004 Dubai hosted the Gulf's first Ashara Mubaraka assembly, which drew close to 40,000 people from around the world.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2004

## MENASCO Scope

Burhani Masjid in Al Qusais is one of the largest Dawoodi Bohra masjids in the Gulf region, built on land granted by the Dubai government in 2001 and inaugurated in 2004. The project was delivered with Al Hudaiba Contracting as main contractor and Artec as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the masjid, providing its mechanical, electrical and plumbing services.
